title: whydiff snapshot v1
description: Snapshot format v1: header, style table and the visible nodes of one screenshot, kept next to its PNG as .whydiff.json. Boxes and points are CSS px of the top-level document unless a field says otherwise.

tool.description: Tool that produced the snapshot and the browser it ran in.

version.description: Version of @whydiff/capture that wrote the snapshot.

source.description: How the snapshot was read: cdp, through the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

browser.description: Browser name and version the page ran in.

capturedAfterMs.description: Milliseconds from Playwright's screenshot to this capture, on the actual side of a failed assertion; absent on baselines, two-run snapshots and snaps.

image.description: How snapshot coordinates map onto the PNG taken next to it.

width.description: Width of the PNG in its pixels.

height.description: Height of the PNG in its pixels.

layoutFactor.description: Divisor that turned protocol layout units into CSS px; diagnostics only.

origin.description: Document point that the PNG's top-left pixel shows.

fullPage.description: Whether the screenshot shows the whole scrollable page.

root.description: Index of the node a locator screenshot was taken of; absent for a page screenshot.

viewport.description: Visual viewport at capture time, in CSS px.

scrollX.description: Horizontal scroll offset of the page.

scrollY.description: Vertical scroll offset of the page.

content.description: Size of the whole document, in CSS px.

compare.description: The screenshot comparison settings in force, so the differ never reads a Playwright config.

threshold.description: Playwright's threshold: the perceived colour difference, from 0 (strict) to 1 (lax), up to which two pixels match.

maxDiffPixels.description: Playwright's maxDiffPixels: the differing pixels the assertion tolerates; absent when not set.

maxDiffPixelRatio.description: Playwright's maxDiffPixelRatio: the share of differing pixels the assertion tolerates; absent when not set.

animations.description: Playwright's animations option: disabled or allow.

caret.description: Playwright's caret option: hide or initial.

scale.description: Playwright's scale option: css keeps one PNG pixel per CSS px, device multiplies by the device scale factor.

frames.description: The documents of the page; index 0 is the main frame.

owner.description: Index of the iframe node in the parent frame; null for the main frame.

offset.description: Offset added to child coordinates to reach the top-level document.

status.description: How a frame was captured; approximate means its offset ignores a CSS transform on the iframe.

masks.description: Boxes of the elements Playwright's mask option covered.

sheets.description: The author stylesheets of the page, each identified by its text hash.

href.description: URL of a linked sheet; absent for inline and constructed sheets.

inline.description: Set for a <style> element's sheet; absent for linked and constructed sheets.

hash.description: Empty when the browser could not read the text back: a sheet that failed to load, or a linked sheet served by page.route or routeFromHAR.

harness.description: Set when the owner node carries data-whydiff-harness: the sheet belongs to the test, not the app.

props.description: Property names; values in styles follow this order.

styles.description: Unique value tuples; nodes point into this table.

rules.description: Winning declaration sources in first-use order; absent when the capture did not record them. One source of declarations is a rule of an author sheet, the element's style attribute, an @property rule or a rule of the browser's own sheet.

sheet.description: Index into sheets; absent for the style attribute and the browser's rules.

selector.description: Selector text as the browser reports it; @property --name for a registration.

layer.description: Cascade layer path, outermost first, joined with dots; an anonymous segment reads <anonymous #n>, n counting the @layer { blocks and bare @import ... layer rules of the sheet that declares it in source order, or <anonymous> when the browser did not say where it is. Absent when unlayered.

important.description: Set for the entry of the rule's !important declarations.

inline.description: Set for the element's style attribute.

layer.description: Cascade layer path, as for a rule of a sheet; absent when unlayered.

important.description: Set for the entry of the rule's !important declarations.

oneOf.description: A rule of the browser's own sheet; only declarations point at one, never attributions.

userAgent.description: Set for a rule of the browser's own sheet.

selector.description: Only the selectors of the rule that matched, joined with commas.

layer.description: Cascade layer path, as for a rule of a sheet; absent when unlayered.

important.description: Set for the entry of the rule's !important declarations.

attributions.description: Per row one entry per props entry: the index into rules that set it, or -1 for no author declaration.

declarations.description: Declarations the uses rows point at and the custom properties they read, deduplicated in first-use order; present exactly when uses is.

prop.description: A name of props, or a custom property name.

rule.description: Index into rules of the rule that declared it, or of the @property rule that registered it when it took the registration's initial value; absent when no rule did. An @property rule has the selector @property --name.

value.description: Declared value without !important, or the registered initial value; absent when nothing gave one.

initial.description: Set when value is the registered initial value.

inherited.description: Set for a custom property declared on an ancestor.

reads.description: Indices into declarations of the custom properties the value reads, in order of first appearance, each below this entry's index; a name already on the path from the longhand, or past the depth capture follows, is left out.

uses.description: Per attributions row, the indices into declarations of the winning declarations of its longhands that read custom properties or, where no author declaration won, come from the browser's own sheet; in props order.

nodes.description: The visible nodes of the render tree, in document order. Field names are short because files hold thousands of them.

i.description: Index in nodes; dense, in document order.

p.description: Index of the nearest emitted ancestor, -1 for a root.

f.description: Index in frames; absent for the main frame.

tag.description: Tag name in lower case; a pseudo-element's is its element's.

role.description: Role from the browser's accessibility tree.

name.description: Accessible name from the browser's accessibility tree.

testId.description: The test id attribute: data-testid unless the capture named another.

cls.description: The class attribute, split at white space.

text.description: The element's own text: its rendered text children joined, white space collapsed, at most 80 characters.

value.description: Current value of an input or textarea.

checked.description: Whether a checkbox or radio input is checked.

lineBoxes.description: One box per rendered line of text, when the text wraps.

scroll.description: Scroll offset and scrollable size of an inner scroller.

img.description: Hash of the image URL actually chosen for an img.

layer.description: Paint layer index shared by all nodes of a layer.

stacking.description: Set when the element starts a stacking context.

font.description: Platform font actually used for the text.

flags.description: Per-node markers that the protocol does not express as styles.
